_meta.description: Compose batch of two slots on experiment.pulse, the control and variant arms, each an AGG_WELFORD of revenue by region (each group's {mean, variance, n}), decorated with an OVERLAY_Z_VS_REF group overlay: a two-sample z-test of each variant region against the same control region, read from those moments, so it needs no variance or n params (a scalar aggregation slot must supply them; there is no default). Each entry's summary.statistic is the two-sided p-value (about 0.004 to 0.009 in east, north and south, 0.18 in west), equal to TEST_Z_TWO_SAMPLE's on the same moments; the normal-tail twin of OVERLAY_T_VS_REF (32_compose_t_vs_ref.json) and series sibling of OVERLAY_Z_CELL (pairwise-z-matrix.json). A region missing from the reference emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO with ref_missing. Buffered.
_meta.name: compose-z-vs-ref
